steps.say: With sales loaded, the grid is where the comparables get chosen. This video covers the star column, comp tags, exclusion reasons, and the row colours.
Click the star on a sale to make it the next comparable. Stars are numbered in the order you click, and the numbers appear on the map.
Right-click a star for the tag menu. A sale can be a numbered comparable, or go into Land Set 1 or Land Set 2 for a two-tier land analysis.

do.eval: const el=document.querySelector('#results tbody tr:nth-child(5) td.fav-col button.fav-star'); if(el){const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(); el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:r.x+8,clientY:r.y+8}))}

steps.say: Untick a row to exclude the sale. A popover asks why. Pick a reason or type one, and it is kept with the sale and printed in the work file.
Row colours flag what needs a second look. Orange is an outlier more than two standard deviations from the rest. Green marks parcels that sold together as one multi-parcel sale.
The draw tools narrow the sales by area. Draw a circle around the subject and only sales inside it stay. Click the shape to switch it to exclude.
If an older job has stars that were added before numbering existed, a Number starred button appears and fills in the comp numbers, so the job comes forward cleanly.
Export C S V writes the filtered sales with their comp tags and exclusion reasons. Charts opens the analysis page in a new window, which is the next video.
